summary: Generate a data dictionary for the selected org in one or more formats.
description: Connects to the target org, describes its sObjects, and produces a data dictionary in the requested formats: Excel (.xlsx), HTML report, JSON, or Markdown. The HTML format also produces an interactive schema map under <output>/schema/.

output.summary: Destination directory and base file name (extension is appended per format).

includemanaged.summary: Include objects from all managed packages.

includestandardsobjects.summary: Additional standard objects to include (Account, Contact, and User are included by default).

includemanagedpackages.summary: Comma-separated namespaces of managed packages whose objects should be included.

format.summary: Output formats to generate. One or more of: xlsx, html, json, md.

errors.noMatchingObject: The Object '%s' does not seem to exist in this org.
errors.unknownFormat: Unknown format(s): %s. Allowed: xlsx, html, json, md.
